title: 7 years building a Mafia RPG, heres how we develop today.
author: RobMafioso
selftext:
Our browser based Mafia RPG has been continuosly developed for 7 years now, and in the last year we have almost completely converted into an AI driven workflow where most of, if not all of the code changes are made with AI, primarily Codex with the latest and best models available.

We strive to keep the quality and security up to par by applying strict rules and extensive workflow designs. 

The game has a try now button which lets you play instantly without registering. You can opt out of marketing and analytics, no issue. We keep all our data for ourselves and internal improvements.

The game is free to play, but we do offer ingame currency sales.

Try it at: [https://mafiosocity.com/](https://mafiosocity.com/)

**C****urre****ntly only available in Europe**. We can open up to specific areas on demand, please ask.

Our landing page has all the details of our self hosted/maintained servers and more.

AI generated core/essence of our development, which currently works extremely well and lets us focus more on community and concept development:

**Give AI durable context**. Keep architecture, game rules and security requirements in versioned project docs so every session starts informed.

**Keep parallel work isolated.** Separate branches and worktrees, with ownership checks to prevent agents overlapping.

**Automate verification**. Relevant tests on each change, full regression nightly, and checks that the accepted code actually reached production.

**Keep the server authoritative.** Validate permissions, prices and rewards server-side. Use transactions and duplicate-claim protection for money and inventory.

**Turn bugs into lasting safeguards**. Reproduce the failure, fix it, then add a meaningful regression test or improve the shared tooling.

**Keep humans responsible for gameplay.** Green tests can confirm the wrong design. Playtesting and human approval still matter

If you have specific questions, critics or just want to discuss the way we solved things, we love a good debate, and we appreciate all kinds of feedback.

\- The Mafioso team

comments.body: 1508 players does not sound too much for 7 years ? has this game been a sideproject ?

replies.author: RobMafioso
replies.body:
Mostly a sideproject as we are all in full jobs and two of us have kids..
We've also been open only to norway for most of the time. Opened up for europe recently. Hoping to gain enough traction to open a US based server when the timing is right. Also havent been pushing too much ads in the earlier years.
The community we've built is a strong core though, with lasting friendships and alot of fun.
